title: Terms & Conditions
subtitle: General terms, appointment booking guidelines, and clinic protocols governing patient care at Dr. Anubhuti Dental Studio.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
content: By accessing our website, scheduling consultations, or receiving dental treatment at Dr. Anubhuti Dental Studio, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms & Conditions.
These terms apply to all patients, visitors, guardians, and individuals utilizing our clinical services or website facilities.

sections.title: 2. Appointments & Scheduling
content: Appointments can be booked online, over the phone, or in person at our Bareilly studio. We request patients to arrive 10 minutes prior to scheduled appointments.
If you need to reschedule or cancel your appointment, please notify our reception team at least 24 hours in advance to allow another patient in need to utilize the time slot.
Treatment estimates and consultation fees are communicated clearly prior to beginning any procedure.

sections.title: 3. Payment & Billing Policies
content: Payment for consultations and dental procedures is due at the time of service, unless installment plans (such as for clear aligners or full-mouth rehab) have been agreed upon in writing.
We accept major payment methods including cash, UPI, debit cards, credit cards, and bank transfers.

sections.title: 4. Patient Care & Clinic Hygiene Guidelines
content: We maintain international-grade autoclave sterilization and single-use protocol standards to ensure patient safety.
Patients are expected to provide complete and accurate medical history (including allergies, ongoing medications, and pre-existing health conditions) prior to undergoing procedures.

sections.title: 5. Emergency Care & Liability
content: We provide dedicated emergency care for severe dental pain and trauma. For life-threatening medical emergencies, patients should visit the nearest general hospital emergency department.
Dr. Anubhuti Dental Studio is committed to delivering evidence-based clinical care; outcome success relies on adherence to post-treatment care instructions provided by our dental team.

sections.title: 6. Governing Law & Jurisdiction
content: These Terms & Conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Uttar Pradesh, India.
Any legal claims or disputes arising out of clinic services shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh.
